ov: The smallest of all whales, dolphins and porpoises, found only in the far north of the Gulf of California in Mexico. It is grey with black rings around its eyes and lips. It is on the brink of extinction, drowned as bycatch in illegal gillnets set for another fish, the totoaba.
rg: Only the upper Gulf of California, Mexico: the smallest range of any whale or porpoise.
df: Bottom-living fish such as grunts and croakers, plus crustaceans and squid.
fx: Scientists described it from skulls in 1958, but a fresh body to show what it looked like was not found until 1985.
Its name is Spanish for "little cow".
